description: This file defines configuration classes and extension methods for setting up an Event Data Generator Stream within Orleans, specifically for Event Hubs integration. It includes interface definitions, extension methods for configuration, and a class that sets up the stream configurator with dependency injection and options.

classes.name: EventDataGeneratorStreamConfigurator
classes.description: Configures and initializes the Event Data Generator Stream for Orleans, setting up dependency injection, options, and validation.

methods.name: UseDataAdapter
methods.description: Extension method to configure the data adapter for the stream configurator.

methods.name: ConfigureCachePressuring
methods.description: Extension method to configure cache pressure options for the stream.
